high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an article on The Economic Times App, which has 10 million downloads as indicated at the top of the screen. The headline reads: "RCB victory parade cancelled thanks to Bengaluru's nagging problem. But you can still meet victorious Kohli & crew." The main part of the image features a photograph of the Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) cricket team celebrating their victory. The players are dressed in their red and blue uniforms, holding up a trophy, and posing for a group photo on a stage with fireworks in the background.
